Anam, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS variable generated from tokens.json, read from anam.ai's public pages on 2026-11-09: the sites' own variables where one matches what the page paints, and computed styles of the real elements everywhere else. Each token's source is in the tables. Toggle Dark for the theme the docs apply under their theme menu.

Three surfaces, one accent: the Framer marketing pages (white ground, black ink and pills, orange #ff6200, frosted glass on the avatar videos), the Next.js app pages /pricing, /get-demo and /tools (a small :root token set), and the Mintlify docs (a warm-stone ramp, the only surface with a dark theme). Inter is the real UI face; IBM Plex Mono stands in for Paper Mono and the licensed MD Thermochrome display face. Component mock-ups are drawn with the tokens; the real components are the crops in components.md.

Palette

One orange carries the brand — #ff6200, lighter on hover, deeper on /tools, 5-10% tints behind it. The marketing site works in black, white and one gray; the apps add pure-black alpha steps; the docs run on an eleven-step warm-stone ramp. The cream pair (#fff8ed/#4a1c00) survives from the Framer body tokens as an accent ground.

Roles

The semantic layer: page grounds, text levels, borders, the accent and the button slots in the current theme — aliases into the palette where the chain ends on a scale step. The dark set is the docs' theme only.

TokenValueSource

Typography

Inter everywhere: 40px display on the hero, 48px on the CTA band, 36/600 for docs titles, 24/500 for feature tabs, and 15/500 on every button. Code splits between IBM Plex Mono (marketing, apps) and Paper Mono (docs). Tracking tightens as sizes grow.

Space and shape

Spacing

A 4px unit on the docs (--spacing); measured paddings land on the same grid — 8, 12, 16, 20, 24 — plus a 20px page gutter and a 1280px content cap on the app pages.

Radius

Pills at 50px on marketing (999px inside the consent card), 6-16 on docs controls, 20 on the search dialog, and the signature 32px on persona cards and the footer's dark panel.

Elevation

Two shadows carry the depth: the floating card's short 12/32/-8 drop plus a 1px contact shadow, and the persona card's long soft column reaching 124px down. Everything else separates by fill and hairline.

Motion

150ms ease on docs controls, 160-240ms on the consent card's rise, and the carousel's 300ms gentle overshoot cubic-bezier(.12,.23,.5,1). Click a track to play its curve.

Focus

anam.ai largely lets the browser's own outline stand: Framer links take the default auto outline, and the docs' buttons keep their resting paint under :focus-visible. Where a ring is wanted, it is the accent colour.

Layout

Read at 1440 x 900. The marketing pages are a floating 100px-tall pill nav over full-bleed Framer sections on a 1240-1280 grid; /pricing and /tools run Next.js layouts on the same 1280 cap; the docs are Mintlify's three rails: 288 sidebar, 768 content, 304 TOC.

Dark theme

Toggle Dark above: only the docs ship one — a pure #000 ground, warm-stone text (#e6e1de headings, #a6a19e body), gray-800 hairlines, and the same #ff6200 accent. The marketing pages and the app pages have no dark theme.
